items.title: 谷歌云服务在欧洲大面积中断，波及汇丰银行、等多家金融企业
items.description: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，英国夏令时今日 11:00（北京时间 18:00）， 谷歌云欧洲西部 2 区域多项服务出现问题 ，涵盖 Google App Engine、Google BigQuery、VMware Engine、Cloud NAT、Google Compute Engine 等。 据科技媒体 neowin 报道，汇丰银行（HSBC）、Revolut、苏格兰银行（Bank of Scotland）、劳埃德银行（IT之家注：Lloyds Bank）等金融企业已确认其服务受影响。问题原因很可能与谷歌云中断有关，波及使用谷歌云服务的各大企业。 以 Revolut 为例，该公司已确认旗下所有业务均受影响，包括注册、登录、支付与转账、账户充值、ATM 取款、股票交易和加密货币相关服务。 谷歌建议受影响的客户将工作负载迁移至其他可用位置。

items.title: Linux 7.4 引入约 1.7 万行 Rust 内核代码，Zerocopy 一次跨越八个版本
items.description: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，据 Phoronix 今日报道，Linux 7.4 的合并窗口已经开启，Rust for Linux 项目负责人 Miguel Ojeda 向内核主线提交了本轮 Rust 代码的拉取请求。 这批代码规模约 1.7 万行，是近期 Rust 内核支持中体量较大的一次更新，核心变化主要涉及 Zerocopy 库升级、内核基础设施改进及安全初始化机制增强。 最显眼的变化来自 Zerocopy crate。这个库为原始字节序列与结构化类型之间的安全转换提供 trait 和宏，Linux 7.4 将它一次性向前推进了八个版本。 由于 Zerocopy 直接参与内核中零拷贝路径的数据解释，版本跨度如此之大，意味着相关安全抽象和诊断信息会同步跟进。 与之配套的是工具链层面的调整：Rust for Linux 7.4 启用了不稳定的 proc_macro_span 特性，让所有过程宏的编译期诊断能够指向更精确的源码位置，而不是笼统地报错在宏调用处。 除库更新外，此次 Rust 内核代码还将调整工具链和基础设施，启用不稳定的 proc_macro_span 特性，以改善各

items.title: OpenXR 标准新增“空间容器”特性：支持 XR 应用在场景中多任务运行，可取得类似苹果 visionOS 体验
items.description: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，负责推动 OpenXR 标准发展的 Khronos Group 宣布推出一项名为“空间容器”（Spatial Containers）特性，其由系统统一管理，允许应用在其中展示 XR 内容，工作方式类似于传统桌面操作系统中的应用窗口。 根据 Khronos Group 展示的演示视频，“空间容器”支持两种运行模式：一种是用于多任务操作的“有界”模式，允许应用在空间环境中与其他内容并行显示；另一种则是“沉浸式”模式，应用可以占据整个视野。借助这一机制，开发者能够更灵活地控制应用在 XR 环境中的呈现方式。 外媒 Road to VR 表示，这一设计与苹果 visionOS 交互逻辑功能颇为相似，用户可以在空间环境中随意运行多个应用，相比之下，其竞品 Meta Quest 目前的多任务能力仍存在一定限制，用户一次只能运行一个空间应用。 Khronos Group 称，目前“空间容器”特性已完成批准并正式发布， 预计从今年起 OpenXR 生态中的各个平台将陆续开始实现这些功能 。不过，标准发布并不意味着所有现有头显都能立即获得支持，具体仍取决于各平台厂商的实

items.content: 苹果 10 月 19 日宣布，将于 10 月 28 日（北京时间 10 月 29 日凌晨 1:00）在洛杉矶举办「Pro and tell」活动，爱范儿也已同步收到活动邀请函，届时将带来第一手报道。 Counterpoint Research 10 月 19 日发布的初步数据表明，2026 年第三季度中国智能手机出货量同比下降 10%，降至自 2012 年以来的同期最低水平。该机构将市场下滑归因于存储价格上涨带来的物料成本增加，以及供应短缺加剧。 华为以 21.3% 的份额位居第一，出货量同比增长 19%。Counterpoint 认为，季度前期相对稳定的价格，以及畅享、nova 和 Mate 产品线的销售表现支撑了增长；华为自 9 月起涨价，则可能给后续销售带来压力。 苹果以 19.5% 的份额排名第二。报告称，iPhone 18 Pro 系列上市前三周在中国市场的销量，比上一代 Pro 系列同期增长 23.5%；基础款延后发布，也促使部分消费者转向 Pro 机型。这项首发销量数据与全季出货量采用不同统计范围。 两家厂商的份额合计超过四成。Counterpoint 指出，面对零部件涨价，其他安卓厂商正通过增加 Pro Max、推出更低价机型或推迟标准版等方式调整产品组合；消费者延后换机、等待促销或转向翻新机的行为，可能继续压制第四季度需求。 10 月 19 日，豆包公关负责人刘星回应「国内超一半算力在造爽剧」的说法，称相关算力数据「有些不靠谱」。他表示，字节跳动总算力中，只有约 10% 用于视频生成模型的训练和推理。

items.title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
items.description: Yelp is embedding numerous new AI features into its app that can do everything from call to check on restaurant wait times to create personalized recommendations that remember your preferences.
items.author: Ivan Mehta
items.content: Buy One Founder Summit Ticket, Get a Second for Free. Register now. Disrupt doors open Oct. 13. Get your pass and bring someone with you at 50% off. REGISTER NOW. Over the last few weeks, personal assistants like Instinct, Fo, and Muse have enabled users to call businesses for customer support and appointment booking. Following this trend, Yelp is adding the ability for its app users to get a voice agent to call a restaurant to check wait times. The new feature, Check for Me, will show up on restaurant pages in the app, where users can enter their party size and phone number. The AI agent then calls on behalf of the user to check wait times and texts them the results to decide if they want to go to that particular restaurant. Last year, Yelp debuted its voice solution for restaurants and service providers . With this new feature, the discovery platform is fulfilling the consumer side of the equation, though there is a possibility that a user’s agent will talk to the restaurant’s agent, and agent-to-agent communication might break down the conversation. The company is also updating its Yelp AI assistant that helps users discover restaurants and services. With the new OpenTable integration, users can easily book a restaurant without leaving the app.

Two of New York’s sweethearts, Mayor Zohran Mamdani and activist and “Broad City” star Ilana Glazer, spoke about AI at Webster Hall in Manhattan on Monday night, with Glazer posing questions to the mayor about the future of AI in society. Mamdani encouraged New Yorkers to resist the overwhelming feeling that AI is inevitably coming for their jobs, their kids’ minds, and their dignity, and to take back control instead. His message came at a moment when the federal government is doing little to regulate AI, leaving cities to act on their own. At The People’s AI Assembly, an event hosted by the AI Now Institute , a think tank that explores the social implications of AI, Mamdani argued that the technology’s rapid rollout is not inevitable and that public officials should hold AI companies accountable. Last month, Mamdani ordered a ban on AI use in elementary and middle schools. Glazer, a parent, said the technology’s arrival in classrooms unsettles her.

Microsoft on Monday introduced new security features designed to protect enterprises from the growing threat of AI agents. The launch comes as Microsoft continues to warn enterprises about the dangers of AI and agents. Perhaps the most notable addition is Guardian Agents , a new feature intended to monitor the AI agents a company uses. Guardian Agents is part of Project Perception, a product introduced in June. Project Perception was Microsoft’s answer to powerful hacking models like Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable and OpenAI’s security vulnerability scanning system Daybreak. Project Perception originally launched three classes of agents: a “red team” that acted like hackers and attacked, a “blue team” that detected the red team and assessed the vulnerabilities they found, and a “green team” tasked with fixing them. The product was designed around the assumption that AI hackers would come from outside the company. But lately, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has been warning that the AI enemy may be the very agents enterprises have deployed and are paying for, much like a rogue human employee, otherwise known as an “insider threat.”

On Monday, Amazon Web Services released a tool called TorchNeuron that lets AI startups easily move their AI apps onto Amazon’s AI chip, Trainium. In doing so, Amazon is also taking a direct stab at the software advantage that has helped Nvidia become the default hardware choice for AI apps and spurred its rise as AI hardware provider of choice. TorchNeuron works with PyTorch, a free, open source toolkit that developers use to build, train, and run AI models. It lets AI apps written with PyTorch run on Trainium by changing just one line of configuration, according to Amazon — no code rewrite required. Amazon says about 85% of AI apps are written with PyTorch. Facebook originally developed it, but since 2022, it has been part of the Linux Foundation, which maintains open source projects. Nvidia has spent years ensuring its CUDA software — the software infrastructure that allows apps to run on Nvidia GPUs and its other hardware — seamlessly supports AI apps written with PyTorch. As a result, Nvidia’s hardware is now deeply embedded in the toolkit, essentially by default. TorchNeuron is adapted from PyTorch, so developers who know PyTorch already know how to use it. Twelve years ago today, Eugenia Kuyda stood up onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt and presented a conversational chatbot called IO that acted as a lifestyle concierge to help people book restaurants and vacations along with other tasks. IO, the first product from her startup Luka, came before the deep learning breakthroughs that would eventually lead to today’s large language models. “ It still worked ,” Kuyda told TechCrunch in an exclusive interview. “It was pretty magical … but, of course, it’s nowhere near what we have today.” Luka ended up becoming Replika, the popular AI chatbot companion company. Last year, Kuyda left as CEO of Replika and founded Wabi . The technology has finally caught up with her original vision for Luka, just in time for Wabi to take on a wave of new personal AI assistants such as Muse and Instinct , which promise to do everything from manage your inbox to find you the best flight deals.
